All sources point to official GitHub repositories under the `123panNextGen` organization, consistent with the package's stated purpose.

No executable code or build instructions are present in this file — it is purely declarative metadata. The use of `git+https` and tagged commits supports reproducibility, and there are no indications of dynamic content fetching during build time (such as `git pull` in prepare/build phases) within this file.
